Tero A. et al. (2010) Rules for biologically inspired adaptive network design, Science 327(5964): 439-442. Methodological basis for the bio-Physarum adaptive network.
Deb K. et al. (2002) A fast and elitist multiobjective genetic algorithm: NSGA-II, IEEE TEVC 6(2): 182-197. Optimization method for the four-objective network renewal problem.

Author's real Physarum + NSGA-II run (167-edge network, optimal efficiency 19.20, heritage objective f3≡f2 [degenerates to cost; no independent site heritage conclusion], Plan03 UDS 80.34). Method-validation evidence only; located ~2-3 km west of the provisional boundary, so not entered as formal geometry. Recorded as metric values in metrics.json and as narrative in proposal.md, not as a geometry layer.
sources.note: Run artifacts are not committed as geometry; the coordinate offset makes direct spatial reuse invalid for this site.

sources.usage: Road-network municipal cost estimate (Plan03 fusion round 2, author run artifact). Itemized: 主干路 740.2 m @ 8000 元/m = 592.2 万元; 次干路 1744.1 m @ 5000 元/m = 872.0 万元; 支路 3679.9 m @ 3000 元/m = 1104.0 万元; 微循环 2648.8 m @ 1500 元/m = 397.3 万元; 合计 8813.0 m = 2965.5 万元 (平均 3365 元/m).
sources.note: Skeleton length 8813.0 m from the real Physarum+NSGA-II run (see PHYSARUM-RUN-RESULTS); unit prices are public Beijing municipal reference levels (公开综合单价, 非定额), 2026 Q2 price level, concept estimate ±30%, pre-allowance 10%. Not a priced bill of quantities or tender/budget figure. Source: output/phase4/plan_03_fusion_round2/10_cost_estimate.md.

sources.usage: 《北京市建设工程计价依据——预算消耗量标准（市政工程）》第二册道路工程 (北京市住建委, 京建发〔2021〕201号, issued 2021-09, effective 2022-01-01). Official 计价依据 (pricing basis) for municipal road engineering. This is a CONSUMPTION standard (人工/材料/机械消耗量) — it defines consumption quantities only and contains NO unit prices (无人材机基价与费用标准). Cited only as the methodological pricing basis.
sources.note: The four unit prices (8000/5000/3000/1500 元/m) used in COST-ESTIMATE-PLAN03 are NOT from this standard (which has no prices). They are the AUTHOR'S CONCEPTUAL ASSUMPTIONS based on public Beijing composite price reference levels (公开综合单价/《北京工程造价信息》信息价), 2026 Q2 price level, ±30% sensitivity interval — not tender results, not priced bills of quantities.
sources.known_limitations: Consumption standard with no unit prices; the unit prices cited are author conceptual assumptions, not verifiable official unit-price schedules.

sources.usage: GB 50763-2012《无障碍设计规范》(Code for accessibility design), mandatory national standard (MOHURD + AQSIQ, 2012). Used as the accessibility-threshold basis (无障碍阈值) throughout the proposal and the T-01/T-03 test scenarios.
sources.note: Official national standard; full text disclosed via 国家标准全文公开系统 (openstd.samr.gov.cn).

sources.usage: GB/T 51328-2018《城市综合交通体系规划标准》(Standard for urban comprehensive transport system planning), recommended national standard. Used as the basis for transport/rail/slow-travel planning in the test scenarios.
sources.note: Official national standard; full text disclosed via 国家标准全文公开系统 (openstd.samr.gov.cn).

sources.usage: GB 50014《室外排水设计标准》(Standard for design of outdoor wastewater engineering), national engineering-construction standard. Used as the basis for stormwater/drainage resilience in the T-02 Xiaoyue River sponge-city test scenario.
sources.note: Official national standard; current edition GB 50014-2021; full text disclosed via 国家标准全文公开系统 (openstd.samr.gov.cn).

sources.usage: 《海绵城市建设技术指南——低影响开发雨水系统构建（试行）》(MOHURD, 2014). Used as the sponge-city technical-guide basis for permeable-paving and green-infiltration ratios in the T-02 test scenario.
